enforced.pageSpecTokenOverrides: NONE EXIST. The PageSpec schema has no style or token field: styling is owned entirely by section/component contracts, so there is nothing token-related to validate at the PageSpec layer (MASTER-GUIDE 3.21). Token drift is checked at the catalog layer by extraction/verify_all.py (catalog == token leaves; every {ref} resolves; theme == foundation; policy keys are real catalog keys).

convention.referenceSemanticFirst: Contracts reference color-roles.* / typography-roles.* before foundation values.
convention.declaredUnused: Tokens with $extensions.usage = declared-unused (accent, danger, radius lg/full, space.declared.*, Vesterbro) exist in the original :root but are never rendered; do not use them for new UI.
convention.fixedPxPerBreakpoint: Type is fixed px per breakpoint (desktop/tablet/mobile); never introduce clamp() or vw sizing.
convention.fontsLicensed: typography.family.primary/secondary are commercial fonts (licence required); font files are not part of this design-repo.
